records.failureSummary: Wrote the slice-2 full-chain regression spec at src/__tests__/slice2-regression.spec.ts (21 tests, every name carries its [AC-xx] marker, AC-01..AC-20 all covered) before the slice-2 UI exists, then ran it: 16 of 21 fail, and every failure is a missing data-testid element in product code, not a wrong assertion. Covered statements: AC-01..AC-05 first screen (exact task-item count and the response order, task-title text per row, empty-state with zero rows, loading-indicator visible while the first GET is held then gone); AC-06 dialog opens and contains task-title-input plus save-task-button; AC-07 empty and whitespace-only titles both render form-error, keep the dialog open and produce zero POST (request log holds only the initial GET); AC-08 dialog closes, the new row is appended with the typed title and task-count goes 3 to 4; AC-09 a 500 keeps error-banner visible, dialog open, count at 3 and the typed title retained; AC-10 save-task-button is disabled while the POST is held open and enabled again after it settles (failure release keeps the dialog open so the restored state is observable); AC-11 keyword narrows the visible rows to the matching one; AC-12 no-results shown and empty-state not shown while the source list is non-empty; AC-13 filter-done shows only the done row; AC-14 filter-all restores all three in server order; AC-15 search plus filter compose (Alpha matches two rows, adding filter-done leaves exactly one, dropping the filter keeps the search); AC-16 data-done goes from the string false to the string true for that row with PATCH /api/tasks/task-1 recorded; AC-17 unmount plus fresh mount re-reads GET (2nd GET) and data-done is decided by the done field returned (true, true, false); AC-18 the deleted row disappears, task-count 3 to 2, DELETE /api/tasks/task-2 recorded;
